newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine official welcomes debate on bank's sale.
newsitem.headline: Argentine official welcomes debate on bank's sale.

text.p: Argentine Cabinet Chief Jorge Rodriguez said Tuesday it would be "interesting" to debate the merits of privatizing state-run Banco Nacion, according to private DyN news agency.

"That debate should go along together with a discussion over the financial system in general," Rodriguez said. "Banco Nacion is the one that charges the lowest rates and hence it helps to push rates down."
"Those who advocate its privatization should explain how interest rates should be pushed down," he says.
President Carlos Menem has repeatedly ruled out the privatization of the bank, Argentina's largest in deposits and second in loans.
